name: cloud-guardian
description: Connect Cloud Guardian to Codex for cloud onboarding, cost investigation, project mentions, and scoped remediation workflows.

interface.longDescription: Sign in to Cloud Guardian, connect cloud accounts, inspect monthly cost estimates, open the native cost overview, and reference connected projects in chat. Bundled skills guide account onboarding and evidence-based cost reviews. Cloud changes use the existing scoped remediation tools.
defaultPrompt: Set up Cloud Guardian and connect my cloud account.
Open my cloud cost overview and explain the largest costs.
Review this project's costs and prepare a remediation plan.
